text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, reliable roommate.
You've got a cute visitor out in the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...? Thank you for letting me know, sir!
I shall report immediately!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this in place of a calling card?
Good grief... there's not even a letter, sir."
"CASE: Special Assignment"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss! Fenomeno, on site!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for the late hour.
Thank you for letting me watch the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe here!!
choice_data_list: You brought Gold Ship along too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Upon checking the situation,
Gold Ship-san had already submitted
her night outing permit as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...The paper explicitly states this trainer's office as
her destination. If I didn't bring her here,
she'd be classified as missing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Trainer, wanna eat a roof tile?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What do you take the Boss for?!
choice_data_list: Then I'll turn on the TV.

text_block_list.text:
Our viewing of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe started off peacefully.
However, that atmosphere—instantly changed.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In second place is Orfevre!
Orfevre is moving up!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Still, Orfevre finishes in 2nd place once again!!
What a truly... truly frustrating result!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—However, this frustration is proof of how much we believed in her strength!
And we will continue to believe in her from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: If anyone can take on the world—it has to be her!!
Fenomeno and the others stare intently at the screen. And then—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Hahaha.
Looks so yummy~. Can Golshi-chan eat it?
Or will it swallow me up instead?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah... On such foreign turf,
without even letting the difference in environment show...
Trying to overpower them through sheer force to the very end—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"To wield that kind of power...
She truly is—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Strong.

Despite the late hour,
breaking news alerts related to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
popped up on the smartphone one after another.

Why is every single move Orfevre makes reported in such detail?
Why are people so captivated by Orfevre?

That is because Orfevre
—is the strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Orfevre-san! Excellent work on your second Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! So, what's next—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It's the Arima.

text_block_list.name: @Race_Maniac
text_block_list.text: "【Good News】 Orfevre to the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: @nununu
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa~ Fenomeno and Gold Ship
have no chance of getting 1st place now.
Those two are pretty entertaining though~"

text_block_list.name: @Turf_Dweller
text_block_list.text:
"'Prediction: Golshi will mess around.
Phenomeno-san, thanks for your hard work~'"

"‘Justice always wins, right?
So what does it mean if Fenomeno loses?’"
"At the very least, the champion of justice we looked up to is gone."
"That tweet was awful, wasn't it? Turning on her all of a sudden like that. And here I thought they liked Fenomeno."

"If you had stayed a hero of justice until the very end,
I could have cheered for you."
The internet was overflowing with all kinds of voices. People whose attitudes had softened since summer. People who had even begun attacking Fenomeno.
choice_data_list: ...I hope Meno isn't watching...

text_block_list.text: When she started social media, I made her promise not to look at the comments, but... if her strong sense of responsibility kicks in—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "Fenomeno made villains out of us, so he'll lose. Because he's not an ally of justice," huh...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...That is not the case.
I do not mean to reject you as a person.
I just... want to stop your actions...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I must win.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I will win.
The justice I found will triumph, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose. I won't falter.
If I lose like this... it means letting you take my future away.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—I don't want any of you to end up on the side of evil,
robbing others of their future...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I will protect them. ...Both that child and all of you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That's why, even against someone as strong as Orfe-san—
Fenomeno's training for the day was set at a 14-14 pace. But when I clocked her time...
choice_data_list: (13 seconds per furlong... That's clearly fast.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, the next...! 
Your next orders............!

"Without even stopping to wipe off her sweat,
Fenomeno presses on for the next thing.
Is it impatience that drives her?"
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, got it. Next is yours, Meno.
...Yeah, got it. Next up, right, Meno?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'm off today...?
And tomorrow too...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wha, why, Boss!?
Every single day counts right now as we prepare for the Arima Kinen—!
choice_data_list: Why are you in such a hurry?
Why are you in such a rush?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That is... because I must not lose.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"As an ally of justice by my own decree!
There are things I simply must do!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Justice never falters!
We must not yield!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate,
that crying boy's future will...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I won't be able to protect that boy's future, or everyone else's!
That's why I—!!"
choice_data_list: Meno, stop!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Stop?
choice_data_list: Is having justice on your side so you won't yield to your opponent?
Is your sense of justice meant to keep you from bowing to your opponent?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: You became a hero of justice to protect others.
You became a champion of justice to protect others, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes! That's why—
choice_data_list: That's why I want to be an ally of justice, too.
That's why I want to become an ally of justice too!

text_block_list.text: (CLATTER-RATTLE!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Golshi-san?
Why are you here—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're the ones who left it unlocked, ain'tcha?
Cold-brewing kelp dashi takes time, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mame-chin.
I'm running in the Arima Kinen too, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna beat Orfe first! You won't be doing a darn thing, na-na-na-boo-boo!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Hah.
...Wh-What? Y-You...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"And also, the zig-zag grass separators in bento boxes.
I gotta prepare for the contest to make those, too."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Shall we make some sushi?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Um, Golshi-san.
Are you—
choice_data_list: Even Gold Ship is your ally of justice!
Even Gold Ship is your ally of justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: Even now, they want to brighten your future.
Even now, they want to brighten your future.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You...
still wanna make the lights here even brighter?
choice_data_list: You're going to run for us, right? In the Arima Kinen.
You'll run for us, won't you? In the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
choice_data_list: Because competing with you will make Meno stronger.
Because competing with you will make Meno stronger.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...――
...Golshi-san."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah. I was in the middle of a game of Gomoku. See ya~

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: —Fenomeno.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: You've met so many different horse girls and grown so much
You've met so many different horse girls and grown so much.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: You were able to find your own justice
You were able to find your own justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have found my justice... something the old me could never find.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Meeting Gold Ship-san,
Gentildonna-san, and everyone else...
allowed me to find it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I will become strong.
I've grown stronger, step by step."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Together with the heroes of justice
who protected my future.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, you're going to get even stronger.
It's okay, you're going to get even stronger

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: Your sense of justice can protect everyone
Your justice can protect everyone

text_block_list.text:
And when we stepped into the hallway so I could walk Fenomeno back...
she stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Boss. There is a post
I wish to make, as my final one.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: May I borrow your terminal?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text: "I will win."

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text: "‘To protect everyone.’"

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text: "With the Allies of Justice"
